from rich.console import Console
from rich.text import Text
from rich.cells import get_and_apply_character_cell_size_overrides

# This is the Nerd Font character for a downloads folder, which was reported as
# being incorrectly rendered as double-width.
NERD_FONT_DOWNLOADS_ICON = "\U000f024d"

def test_nerd_font_character_width():
    """
    Test that a specific Nerd Font character is correctly identified as single-width.
    """
    # Ensure the character width overrides are applied
    get_and_apply_character_cell_size_overrides()

    console = Console(width=80, record=True)
    text = Text(NERD_FONT_DOWNLOADS_ICON)

    # Render the text to get its cell width
    with console:
        console.print(text, end="")
    
    # The rendered text should have a width of 1, as it's a single character
    # that should be treated as single-width.
    # If the bug is present, this will be 2.
    rendered_width = console.measure(text).maximum

    assert rendered_width == 1, (
        f"Nerd Font character '{NERD_FONT_DOWNLOADS_ICON}' "
        f"was incorrectly measured as {rendered_width} cells wide, expected 1."
    )
